dogecoin.text: When Robinhood froze trading of GME and AMC in January, I thought: “This is probably the most bullish thing ever to happen to DeFi.” When it halted Dogecoin trading at the peak of Elon mania in April, I thought the same thing.
Right now, Robinhood supports trading for Bitcoin (#BTC), Ethereum (#ETH), but also Dogecoin (#DOGE), Bitcoin Cash (#BCH), Bitcoin SV (#BSV), Ethereum Classic (#ETC), and Litecoin (#LTC).
